messages:
Maya Chen: Hi all — first day! Booted my MBP and after the Apple setup it asked for a FileVault recovery key and won't let me finish setup. I never got to the "Remote management" prompt. macOS 14.2. Any ideas?
IT Support: Welcome Maya! Can you tell us model + serial and whether you restored from backup during setup?
Maya Chen: MacBook Air (M2) serial: C02ZXY12345. I chose "Transfer from another Mac" briefly but then cancelled because it was slow.
device-bot: [device-lookup] Model: MacBookAir10,1; ABM: assigned; MDM record: provisioning_pending; FileVault: not yet enabled; recovery_key_state: unknown
IT Support: The transfer attempt can trigger FileVault to start encrypting before MDM finishes. If the setup assistant asks for a recovery key, it's usually because a local key was created. Try hitting the "I don't have the key" option to continue network setup — if that isn't shown, hold the machine on the WiFi and drop to Terminal (Cmd+Option+F) and run:
```bash
# attempt to renew enrollment
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
# check fde
sudo fdesetup status
``` 
Maya Chen: Ran profiles renew -> "Enrollment operation failed: profile server returned 404". fdesetup status -> FileVault is Off. But setup still says recovery key required.
Devex Raj: @IT Support this smells like partial ABM handshake — device assigned in ABM but not yet supervised in Kandji. Maya, please keep it on REDWOOD-EMP and don't skip network screens. IT can push the enrollment record.
IT Support: Samir (IT) — can you force-create the device in Kandji with serial C02ZXY12345? We'll also remove the interrupted transfer flag.
IT Support: Also as a workaround, if you have a USB with a recent macOS installer, we can do a clean install from Recovery with Command+R and start without transfer — that avoids the half-created recovery key.
Maya Chen: Samir pushed the device record. I rebooted and now it shows "Remote management: Your device is supervised by Redwood" and setup continues. Logged in, ran sudo fdesetup status -> FileVault: On, key escrowed to Kandji. All green. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Devex Raj: Welcome Maya! Ping #devex for the dotfiles script and we can set up docker / dev certs this afternoon. :wave:
